subject: Insurance
title: The Risk Pool
description: A fast breakdown of The Risk Pool for builders.

hook.text: 10,000 people each pay $1,000 a year. That $10 million pool pays the 50 people who have claims.

buildup.text: Risk pooling is insurance's core mechanism. Many pay in, few claim out.

discovery.text: Pools work best when risks are independent. Car accidents in Texas don't affect car accidents in Maine.

twist.text: Pools fail when risks are correlated. A hurricane hits all Florida policyholders at once.

climax.text: A good risk pool has diverse, independent risks. A bad one has concentrated, correlated ones.

quiz.question: When do risk pools fail?
options: When risks are correlated and everyone claims at once
